chunks: He said: And Hannan ibn Sadir narrated to me from Ismail al-Bazzaz, who said: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
The master of this affair is the executor of the will, while he is twenty years old.
Ismail said: By God, no one became the executor of the will who was younger than him; and he was indeed of the age which Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) had mentioned.

key_terms.صَاحِبَ الْأَمْرِ: The master of the affair / The leader

ai.seo_question: Who was the executor of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq's will and what was his age according to the hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* serves as a critical proof for the Waqifiyya sect, who held that Imam Musa al-Kadim (a.s.) was the final Imam and did not succeed to his son, Imam al-Rida (a.s.). The specific mention of the age of twenty highlights the precision of the Imamate's succession, with Ismail al-Bazzaz noting that no predecessor had ever held the position at such a young age, thereby emphasizing the unique and early establishment of Imam Musa al-Kadim's authority.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 38 - Narrated to me Hannan bin Sudair from Ismail [bin Ziyad] Bazzaz that he said: Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) said:
The master of this affair is the executor of the will, while he is twenty years old.
After that Ismail said: No one became the executor of the will of Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) who was younger; and Imam Kadhim (a.s) was of the age, which Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) had mentioned.
